column3: NASB supplies “He said” for the Hebrew “saying,” which introduces verses 6–21.
“the house of slavery” renders “a house of slaves.”
“an idol” renders “an image”; the Hebrew has no “or” before “any likeness.”
“who stays with you” renders “who is in your gates.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB does not render the opening “and” of verses 18–21.
“Oh that” renders the Hebrew wish “Who will give”; “sons” renders “children.”
